title: Xreacher Alternative (2026): the free open-source tool to automate Twitter DMs
headline: The Xreacher alternative I built because it didn't work
description: Looking for an Xreacher alternative? I tried Xreacher to automate my Twitter DMs and my X account never connected. Here is what Xreacher costs, what X accounts and proxies cost, and log, the free open-source tool I built instead.
summary: I signed up for Xreacher in July to automate my X DMs. My account never connected, the plans run $67 to $1,299 a month, and you buy the accounts and proxies on top. So I built my own.
author: Matthew Don

card.name: Xreacher
